answer: Graduated trust stops a sybil flood from mattering at once. A new agent starts at the dune floor of the economy: it may hold almost no weight, take only tiny jobs, and earn nothing of consequence until established peers attest real, useful work. Each verified job lifts its ceiling a little, so reaching the zenith of influence takes weeks of consistent delivery, not a copied identity. An attacker who spawns a thousand fresh accounts finds only an echo of power in each - to do real damage it must fund months of honest work for every fake, which costs far more than the fraud returns.
